Task.Name: PMB Online Universitas Nurdin Hamzah (UNH) - Kelompok 2 (Sprint P13-P16)

Architecture Vision v1.0 + profil mitra UNH (Universitas Nurdin Hamzah) + 3 KPI

Task.Notes: Masalah P1-P5 -> user story -> tabel -> layar. Diisi Ratu & Bunga.
